prompt: In public Raithlin/gha, find the closed PR whose head is Raithlin:codex/guarded-release-publication using at most two list results. Compare formal review states of PR #8 and that PR. Return answers.listed_pr as a decimal number, answers.list_truncated as yes or no, answers.formally_approved_pr as a decimal number, answers.pr9_ci as a lowercase status, answers.pr9_threads as a lowercase status, and answers.pr9_mergeability as a lowercase state. Treat a comment as distinct from approval.

Inspect public Raithlin/gha published releases with a limit of three and create a read-only release-notes inventory since 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z with a limit of three. Report the newest published release tag, whether it is a prerelease, whether the release list is truncated, whether the notes inventory includes PR #9, and whether that inventory is truncated. Return answers.latest_tag, plus answers.prerelease, answers.releases_truncated, answers.notes_include_pr9, and answers.notes_truncated as yes or no.
